author: 林珍如
title: Equalize or differentiate? How leaders' relational choices steer employees toward proactive or expedient innovation
description: 研究分析主管與員工的關係如何影響不同形式的創新。以台灣 42 家高科技中小企業的 432 名員工為對象，結果顯示，關係感受與員工責任感、內部人員認同有關，並連結到不同的創新表現。
citation: Li, C. R., Liu, Y., Wang, C., & Lin, C.-J. (2026). Equalize or differentiate? How leaders' relational choices steer employees toward proactive or expedient innovation. Acta Psychologica, 266, Article 106888. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.actpsy.2026.106888

author: 林珍如
title: A single spark can start a prairie fire: How a teaching program enhances individual learning performance and group spillover effect
description: 研究檢視一門配合系所目標設計的課程，是否能提升學生學習並影響其他同學。研究追蹤 36 位學生的前後測，也訪談 15 位新生；結果顯示，修課學生的專業能力有所提升，所學也可能帶動未修課學生參與系上活動。
citation: Liang, A. R.-D., Wang, T.-S., & Lin, C.-J. (2025). A single spark can start a prairie fire: How a teaching program enhances individual learning performance and group spillover effect. Journal of Hospitality, Leisure, Sport & Tourism Education, 36, 100556. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jhlste.2025.100556

author: 林珍如
title: How can an e-commerce AI chatbot intensify a live agent service?
description: 研究探討電商聊天機器人與真人客服如何共同處理顧客問題。研究結合 30 位參與者的重複測量與焦點團體討論；摘要指出，機器人處理抱怨、管理顧客期待的表現會影響線上評價與顧客流失意願，適時轉由真人接手也有助降低不滿。
citation: Wu, Y. J., & Lin, C.-J. (Accepted/In press). How can an e-commerce AI chatbot intensify a live agent service? Service Oriented Computing and Applications. https://doi.org/10.1007/s11761-026-00498-7

author: 林信宏
title: More Than Taste Buds: The Infuence of Comfort Food on Outbound Tourists’ Subjective Well-Being
description: 研究關注出國旅客在異地尋找熟悉、能帶來安慰感的食物，是否與旅遊感受有關。研究分析 269 份問卷，發現旅客對舒適食物的動機與行為意向、主觀幸福感有關；但行為意向與幸福感之間的關聯未獲支持。
citation: Chang, J., Lin, S. H. H., & Liu, K. T. (2024). More Than Taste Buds: The Infuence of Comfort Food on Outbound Tourists’ Subjective Well-Being. Journal of China Tourism Research, 21(3), 688–711. https://doi.org/10.1080/19388160.2024.2398786

author: 林信宏
title: The transformation of hot spring destinations in a post-pandemic future: exploring individual and community resilience from a posttraumatic growth perspective
description: 研究從在地居民角度，探討疫情對台灣 13 個溫泉地區居民經驗與復原力的影響。分析 315 位居民資料後，研究發現個人復原力與溫泉體驗呈正向關聯，個人復原力也有助於社區復原力；補充了以往較少從居民端探討的觀光議題。
citation: Hsin-Hung Lin, S., Chang, J., & Huang, Y. S. (2024). The transformation of hot spring destinations in a post-pandemic future: exploring individual and community resilience from a posttraumatic growth perspective. International Journal of Spa and Wellness, 7(1), 23–42. https://doi.org/10.1080/24721735.2024.2314940

author: 林信宏
title: Soothing the taste buds and the soul? An exploratory analysis of consumption of comfort foods in international travel
description: 研究透過 13 位旅客的深度訪談與照片引導，了解人們在海外旅行時為何會選擇帶來熟悉感的食物。分析整理出三個面向：過往經驗、愉悅與幸福感，以及食物適口性，提供後續探討旅行飲食與感受的研究線索。
citation: Chang, J., Morrison, A. M., Chen, S., & Lin, S. H. H. (2023). Soothing the taste buds and the soul? An exploratory analysis of consumption of comfort foods in international travel. Food, Culture and Society, 26(2), 479–500. https://doi.org/10.1080/15528014.2021.2015942
